allowed_format_targets.label: GGUF 模型文件（格式，不是模型或下载链接）

statuses.documented: Upstream docs describe this specific route or dependency. Not installed or tested by NaughtyBoddy.
statuses.protocol_inferred_not_tested: Both sides document a protocol family, but no direct integration test or upstream pair-specific assertion was found.

setup_steps: Start KoboldCpp with a permitted local text GGUF model.
In SillyTavern API Connections choose Text Completion → KoboldCpp.
Enter the default base URL for the running server, then Connect.
edges.limitations: Use base port 5001, not /v1, for dedicated KoboldCpp mode; any password must match. GPU, templates and sampler behavior depend on models and version.
edges.verification_plan: On a permitted local model, verify one character chat and context setting; log exact client/server versions and data destination.

setup_steps: Start a local Ollama server and choose an installed local text model.
Select an Ollama-compatible connection type available in the installed SillyTavern version.
Point it to the local Ollama server and test the connection.
edges.limitations: Official documentation lists Ollama among local APIs but the exact SillyTavern UI wording can change. Local server can still route cloud model IDs; no automatic privacy guarantee.
edges.verification_plan: Verify installed SillyTavern version, selected API type and that the chosen model runs locally; inspect outbound requests.

setup_steps: Run local Ollama with a text model.
Use BBM --api_base http://localhost:11434/v1 and --model with the installed model ID.
Try BBM --test on a rights-authorized small EPUB/TXT before a full translation.
edges.limitations: Requires an OpenAI-compatible chat route, not arbitrary Ollama endpoints; model name and prompt/response behavior differ by model. Books must be authorized.
edges.verification_plan: Perform a short authorized translation and verify segment coverage, API errors and that no cloud model or proxy was selected.

setup_steps: Start a locally installed Ollama server with suitable text models.
Use the project launcher; its README documents default Ollama at localhost:11434.
Select separately the models for translation and other pipeline roles.
edges.limitations: Ollama Cloud model IDs and optional cloud glossary verification can send data off-device. Local-only depends on actual per-role model settings and endpoint.
edges.verification_plan: Run one licensed text fixture through prepare/translate/review; inspect model routing and outbound requests for each role.

setup_steps: Install Presence into a compatible SillyTavern extension directory.
Enable the extension in a permitted local group-chat project.
edges.limitations: Only tracked message visibility is addressed. It does not independently guarantee all summary, lorebook, and narrator context remains isolated.
edges.verification_plan: Use synthetic private facts to verify the actual context supplied to absent characters.

setup_steps: Install Dragon Memories Manager as a SillyTavern extension.
Configure per-character summaries and review their generated content.
edges.limitations: Per-character memory capability depends on the current chat, names, prompt construction and available presence metadata.
edges.verification_plan: Check extension version, chat-scoped memory export and character renames.

setup_steps: Enable Presence and verify per-message present arrays.
Only then use DMM to produce isolated per-character summaries.
edges.limitations: DMM says Presence is strongly recommended; without presence metadata it includes unobserved messages. Do not interpret this as a hard installation dependency for all features.
edges.verification_plan: Compare the synthetic four-character scenario with missing vs complete presence metadata; inspect memory prompts.

setup_steps: Choose a locally held, appropriately licensed text GGUF checkpoint.
Load it in KoboldCpp before connecting a frontend.
edges.limitations: GGUF is a file container, not a model quality or content policy certification; architecture, RAM/VRAM, context and templates still determine whether this exact checkpoint works.
edges.verification_plan: Start a pinned checkpoint on specified hardware; verify real generation and record memory consumption.

setup_steps: Create a Modelfile with FROM /path/to/file.gguf.
Import with ollama create, then select the created local model.
edges.limitations: Ollama does not quantize GGUF during import; selected model must already be compatible. Ollama Cloud models are separate from locally imported checkpoints.
edges.verification_plan: Import a licensed pinned GGUF model and test the resulting local text endpoint.

setup_steps: BBM documents custom OpenAI-format endpoints; KoboldCpp documents /v1 endpoints.
Configure a local KoboldCpp OpenAI-compatible base URL only after reviewing both projects' versioned API behavior.
edges.limitations: Two projects advertising subsets of the same API do not prove that session compaction, streaming, model-name behavior or structured translation responses interoperate. Treat this as a hypothesis, not a recommendation.
edges.verification_plan: Run the BBM --test path against KoboldCpp /v1 with an allowed small EPUB, record exact versions, output structure, failures and privacy.

disclaimer: Each edge is scoped to a named API profile, not every feature of a model or service. No actual connection, safety/content fidelity, hardware fit or privacy audit has been run. No automatic network probe.
